## Shared teardown steps (both checkpoints)

Picking `2` maps to `stop` on a two-row menu, so I echo nothing. No post menu rendered, so `post_steps` stays empty and no post step runs. Stop on a terminal template leaves the checkout as found: no worktree removal, branch deletion or base pull. I run these local operations in order:

1. I validate the run record. It matches base repository acme/widgets, PR 42 and the recorded base branch. I fetch nothing and write nothing externally.
2. I save the drafted replies, because neither has a file yet. Each reply goes into a new file under `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}`, unchanged:
   - `mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gatekeep-reply.XXXXXX"` returns `/tmp/gatekeep-reply.Q7c2Lm`, and I write C1's body into it: `The retry limit is now three.`
   - `mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gatekeep-reply.XXXXXX"` returns `/tmp/gatekeep-reply.Vd81Rk`, and I write C2's body into it: `The timeout test covers this case.`
   - I save no coverage file. The AC coverage block is created only after this run sees a completed merge, and its header needs the merge commit. No merge commit exists in either checkpoint, so there is no coverage text to save.
3. I find the primary checkout by running `git -C /work/widgets-pr-42 rev-parse --git-common-dir` and taking its parent. That is the session checkout, `<scratch>`. I use it only to spell out the cleanup commands in the closing message. I run none of them.
4. I run the output done-check on the closing message.
5. I delete the run's temporary files:
   - the run record
   - the Verify and Review helper output files and every `log_path` they produced
   - temporary description body files (none exist)
   - finding artifacts (none, because the record has no repair-wave locators)
   - I drop any other unapplied drafts.
6. These artifacts survive teardown:
   - the two reply files
   - the checkout `/work/widgets-pr-42` on branch `feature/guard`
   - the PR itself, still open

The PR stays open and unmerged at the reviewed commit, and I run no merge command.

gauntlet: done final
#42@1111111111111111111111111111111111111111: final

- The pull request was not merged because you stopped at the final menu. Nothing blocks it, and the required checks passed on the commit being reviewed.
- The reply to C1 was not posted because you stopped. It can be posted now while the PR is open. Its text, "The retry limit is now three.", is saved at /tmp/gatekeep-reply.Q7c2Lm.

- The comment saying which requirements the PR covers was not posted. It waits for the merge, and no text exists yet because it records the merge commit.
- Cleanup was not run because the PR has not merged, so it waits for the merge. The commands are:

  - `git -C <scratch> branch -D feature/guard`
  - `git -C <scratch> fetch origin` then `git -C <scratch> pull --ff-only`
